mainTrait.name: Marrow
mainTrait.description: Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. 65% Effectiveness for AoE Attacks, 15% against Monsters.

minorBlessing1.name: Leech
minorBlessing1.description: Steal 200% Base Health Regen from Enemy Heroes within 550 Units.

minorBlessing1.name: Blood Bank
minorBlessing1.description: Store 100% of Hero Damage as Charges for 3s. Gain +0.75% Lifesteal per 100 Charges.

minorBlessing1.name: Taste of Iron
minorBlessing1.description: Dealing DoT Damage to Enemy Heroes grants +6% Damage for 3s.

minorBlessing2.name: Roses
minorBlessing2.description: Hero Kills increase Marrow's Healing by 50% for 8s. Takedowns grant +20 Bonus Gold per previous Takedown. Max: 5 Takedowns.

minorBlessing2.name: Jealousy
minorBlessing2.description: While at or below 100%-20% Health, deal +1%-8% Damage.

minorBlessing2.name: The Maw
minorBlessing2.description: Basic Attacks deal +10% Bonus True Damage against Targets below 40% Max Health.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided Harbinger carry Eternal manual entry on 2026-08-22.

mainTrait.name: Vermis
mainTrait.description: Landing 3 Basic Attacks on an Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) Max Health as Physical Damage On-Hit.

minorBlessing1.name: Crush
minorBlessing1.description: Immobilizing an Enemy Hero deals 8% Max Health as Bonus Physical Damage. 8s CD per Target.

minorBlessing1.name: Mechadrive
minorBlessing1.description: Basic Attacks reduce your Secondary Ability's Current Cooldown by 10% On-Hit. Reduced to 5% against Non-Heroes.

minorBlessing2.name: Melting Point
minorBlessing2.description: Deal +10% Damage to Targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

minorBlessing2.name: Breach
minorBlessing2.description: Ultimate Damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.

minorBlessing2.name: Sub-Surface
minorBlessing2.description: Take 7% less Damage from AoE Abilities.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided Harbinger carry Eternal manual entry on 2026-08-22.

mainTrait.name: Weald
mainTrait.description: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 25% Bonus Attack Speed) Projectiles, each dealing 8 (+1 per Level) True Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 30% Effectiveness. 8s CD per Hero.

minorBlessing1.name: Forage
minorBlessing1.description: Gain 4 additional Gold and 4 additional XP per Minion or Monster Kill.

minorBlessing1.name: Dryad's Boon
minorBlessing1.description: Basic Attacks decrease Basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.2s On-Hit.

minorBlessing1.name: Natural Resistance
minorBlessing1.description: Cleanse all Crowd Control and gain +400 Tenacity when below 25% Maximum Health. Cleanse: 20s CD.

minorBlessing2.name: Wind-Rider
minorBlessing2.description: Gain 20% Total Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport or upon leaving Stealth.

minorBlessing2.name: Barkskin
minorBlessing2.description: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This Damage triggers On-Hit Effects at 50% effectiveness.

minorBlessing2.name: Taproot
minorBlessing2.description: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+8% Bonus Physical Power) Health On-Hit.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided Harbinger carry Eternal manual entry on 2026-08-22.

minorBlessing2.name: Immaculate

minorBlessing1.name: Harmonic Currents
minorBlessing1.description: Casting an Ability restores 2% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana.

minorBlessing1.name: Diffusion

minorBlessing2.name: Neurotoxin

minorBlessing2.name: Terror
